notes.title: Qixi Festival Update
notes.content: [p]Regular update for Qixi Festival on August 29, 2025, including decorative items and bug fixes, as well as performance optimization for when there are too many characters. Version: 1.4.3[/p]

notes.title: Update and Repair Announcement (Updated to Version 1.4.2)
notes.content:
Dear internet cafe owners, this regular update is as follows:
1. Added daily statistics interface. Convenient for all bosses to know the operating situation of the internet cafe and adjust their strategies. It also facilitates our research and lays the groundwork for adjusting game values.
2. Fix a display error issue with a decorative model.
3. During the long holiday, one can obtain holiday achievements.
4. Add some fragmented thoughts.

notes.title: Update fix announcement (updated to version 1.4.1)

notes.title: Mid-Autumn Festival version update
notes.content:
Dear bosses, long wait. Update as follows:
1. Special commemorative decorations for Mid-Autumn Festival. As long as you log into the game during the Mid-Autumn Festival, you will get it. At the same time, festival achievements will be obtained. The next holiday achievement will start on National Day.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/7ecf2ebfccf1b09358abd19c4a0ba64e9e8ce7d3.png[/img]

2. We have launched a new game console. In the category of special items. After purchasing, you can start a small game of fighting zombies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/efa6c1d71373d2967a9ac5205416c58cf37cde92.png[/img]

3. We have launched some sci-fi themed trinkets. Convenient for bosses to set up internet cafes with a sci-fi feel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/a6273954b372e03116c082aac826c8de1f709ae3.png[/img]

4. Fixed some known bugs
==========
There are more first person dressing problems than we expected. So we still have to wait for a while. The game will continue to be updated, and subsequent content is also being developed. I don't plan to sell DLC. Everyone knows our situation, and the update speed largely depends on whether our essential work is busy, so please forgive us.

notes.title: Update fix announcement (updated to version 1.3.7)
notes.content:
Dear internet cafe owners, I apologize for keeping you waiting for so long. This is still a minor version update. Mainly to improve the previously incomplete functions. It may not seem like much content, but it is indeed a refactoring of the previous code. Easy to add new content in the future.

1. Improve the functionality of the washbasin to meet the needs of cleanliness conscious users.
2. Game console customers are included in the group process. There will also be demands for food and restrooms.
3. An additional ton of gold has been added, which is extremely expensive. It does not depreciate when bought or sold, but we adjust the gold price every time the version is updated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/c288e2c52d8a63ab8cd815ff828c8af982b6f0e7.png[/img]

The follow-up content is still in production and is more difficult than we imagined. First person gameplay, currently almost all ceilings have been capped. The scenery that may be seen through the doorway is still being filled in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/6cec2b0a9619a85c64ddf119fcb29c4a490a656d.jpg[/img]

Due to insufficient game revenue to cover model outsourcing costs, the work related to the model has not been smooth. But the gameplay that is not limited by the model has been ongoing in the future. We will still make every effort to continuously update the game.

notes.title: May Day Version Update
notes.content:
Hello internet cafe owners, we have updated the May Day version in advance. Due to the modification of some numerical bugs, we will update them first to avoid affecting everyone's gaming experience. The message stacking function of this plan has not been tested yet. After the testing is completed, we will update it tomorrow. Wishing everyone a happy holiday.

The updated content can be found in:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2600600/view/4169846298203697411?l=english

notes.title: May Day version trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone, let me start with good news. A very talented UI lady has joined us, and we have grown a lot. We have prepared a May Day version for everyone, with slightly more updated content. Because there is a decoration inside that is unique to this version. So let me give you a preview and wish everyone a happy May Day. The version will be updated before May Day. The updated content is as follows——

1. Add two new network administrators.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/108b7b3a31148f11baff841a9989e664e0875a96.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/e728dcefb3d302e2da37e4f4eedcd04c3f3f1b33.png[/img]

2. Zheng Haonan and Qu Xiuhua are available in challenge and sandbox mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/7fbc8ef3bf4d3cf2c7d8ad69528e9a803ba7bc8f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/414795235804f906c206a28fcf4e508a07ed853d.png[/img]

3. May Day special event decoration and achievements. (Only available in the May Day version)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/2dda59a86259c1df8270a439c2da25f84f782c03.png[/img]

4. Add letter decoration for A-Z.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/19286ebc169eacd029819235bcb6c711a0d90b87.png[/img]
5. Notification can be stacked to avoid missing personnel recruitment.
6. Add a voice prompt control panel. Some players have reported that there are too many voice calls in the later stage, which is a bit annoying.
7. In story mode, add new targets to complete both the plot and objectives simultaneously, avoiding incomplete storyline experience.
8. Fix numerical errors in movie shooting.
9. Fixed a bug where the cinema had insufficient foot traffic in challenge mode.
10. Remove unreasonable employee tasks.
11. Add a rule that noisy behavior will only be triggered when customer satisfaction is below 60.
12. Add a skip button for appointment animations.

Some players have provided feedback that we are already making modifications, but it is estimated that we may not be able to finalize it before the holiday. We will have plenty of time during the May Day holiday, so let's try to make changes and update later.

[h3][Update content of the May Day post plan][/h3]

1. Add the function of batch replacement of computers.
2. Change the original "sandbox mode" to "company operation" and add a "sandbox mode" with unlimited money.
3. Add "technology level" selection in the new sandbox mode and prominently display it in the "company operation" mode. Avoid always starting with the lowest technology computers.
4. Add a new computer storage warehouse to avoid the need to sell computers when changing tables.
5. Optimize AI pathfinding function. (At present, there is a high volume of passengers, but they are not satisfied with their seats. After investigation, there is also a problem with finding the way.)
6. Optimize AI behavior to improve automatic dissuasion and watering efficiency.


We summarize everyone's suggestions every day and do our best to continuously optimize and update them. In order to communicate with our friends in a timely manner, we have decided to establish an official group: 207023656. Thank you very much for your valuable feedback.

notes.title: Improvement of issues in the official version
notes.content:
Hello everyone, based on your feedback on the new product festival demo version, we have made the following improvements in the official version.

1. Automatic watering and automatic maintenance of the computer. When the current maintenance skill of the network administrator is greater than 60, this ability will be available. However, it should be noted that if a computer is constantly being used by customers, the network administrator will not proactively drive away the customers and perform maintenance. So manual operation is still inevitable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/4eb2f9bff832460e7adfcbda8b22dc428dc977ac.png[/img]

2. Proactively dissuading noisy customers, this ability is possessed when the network management service skill is greater than 60. Smoking customers still need to avoid adverse effects through zoning. The noise shielding function of the advanced esports chair has been fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/823a0f5441e8ddbddac91eab41826d5ab465817f.png[/img]

3. Add front-end closure function. You can stop accepting new customers and leave time to renovate the internet cafe and maintain equipment. And there is no need to forcibly drive away guests.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/6434527b14d1e04889aecb2e3e669932e7f4403d.png[/img]

4. Do not interrupt the game due to failed goals. In challenge mode, if the target is not completed on time, the game will no longer be interrupted, but points for that target cannot be earned. In story mode, non plot related goals will no longer interrupt the game. But goals related to the plot must be achieved.

5. Shop owner skills can be improved. To establish a company in a sandbox, spend 50000 yuan in cash to wash the points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/ac791121f21dbf6fbb025a20ef636575b0811faa.png[/img]

6. When moving green plants, you can see the range of influence of the moving plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/89736e3259c884876dfdabc73b5ecf1e2dc91b17.png[/img]

7. The load-bearing column can be changed to a new style for free.

8. When replacing the computer, customers will no longer leave. (Although it may not be reasonable, the experience will be better.)

9. Dialogue operation optimization. The dialogue is to click on this item to display it as complete, and then click on it to move on to the next item.

10. We have optimized the translation of the English text to make it more accurate.

There are still many good suggestions, and we can only say that we try our best to meet them, as our abilities and time are limited. Recently, more energy has been focused on creating follow-up content. We strive to launch the official version this month. Thank you all.

——Tiny Flame Games

notes.title: Three announcements
notes.content:
[h2]Announcement 1[/h2]

During the New Product Festival, we received a total of 22 image customization requests from our partners, and 13 of them successfully provided their avatars and information through contact. They are:
伊芙Nya，主泉户猫丸，安琪princess，Sherry龙小葵，熊宝玩游戏，Zeus-csgo，柯小圆，福宅宅，丝丝小菜包，睡的醒的豹小豹QAQ，Sasa欧内桑，小草莓味儿o，張稱

Thank you to these buddies for their attention to our obscure game. Your support is our greatest motivation.
At present, the image customization channel is temporarily closed. It will be reopened when our character images become more diverse.


[h2]Announcement 2[/h2]

We will release the full version of the game as soon as possible, expected within two months. There will be no EA stage. We have absorbed a large number of player opinions and benefited greatly. Subsequent esports teams, live streaming management, arcade games, cinemas, and sandbox modes are also being produced. It is worth mentioning that the sandbox model is not simply built, but operates as a company, with personnel and cash being managed uniformly. With the increase of assets, new business licenses can be obtained. Based on player support, the game will also be continuously optimized after the official version is released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44698100/0f65cc42a00cf1c16ed38f6a319a99de4718e843.png[/img]


[h2]Announcement 3[/h2]

Our previous development status was actually quite scattered, but after the game was exposed, we received a lot of support from our friends, as well as a lot of attention from our uploaders. At the same time, we also received cooperation invitations from some third-party companies. But we have no plans to give up our current job at the moment. Afterwards, we will still invest more energy in the development of "Internet Cafe Evolution Theory" without delaying our job. Thank you all.
